hooks.command: mise exec -- jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */pipeline/*.rs) dir="${f%%/pipeline/*}/pipeline"; (cd "$dir" && mise exec -- cargo fmt && mise exec -- cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings) ;; */web/*.ts) dir="${f%%/web/*}/web"; (cd "$dir" && mise exec -- pnpm exec tsc --noEmit) ;; esac; } || true
